wkb.approximation: ADIABATIC (WKB) local plane-wave modes at a fixed hidden position, with no hidden momentum: the warp (sin^2 z)^{1/12} and cot z frozen (wavelengths short compared with the warp scale 1/H; the gravity terms are absent in the half-density variables), the Krein charge of each mode an adiabatic invariant (|d omega/dx4| << omega^2); incoherent superposition (cross terms between different momenta average to zero over 3-space and the extra times; cross terms between frequencies average to zero in time)
wkb.component: rho = omega Q n, p3 = k^2 Q n/(3 a^2 omega), p_t = -q^2 a^2 Q n/(3 b4 omega), p0 = 0, n = e^{a4} b4^{-2}, omega^2 = m^2 + k^2/a^2 - q^2 a^2/b4 (isotropic averages)

wkb.theorem: if every component has rho_i >= 0 (Krein charge of the sign of omega), real frequencies, and total rho > 0, then w_eff(N1) >= 0 and w_eff(N2) >= -(4 - 2 beta)/3 (= -4/9 on the history b4 ~ a^(4/3)) at every a at which these conditions hold (weighted averages of eps_i >= 0 with weights rho_i >= 0): no phantom, no crossing of -1, and no w_eff(N2) below -4/9 there. A mode with extra-time momentum q != 0 loses its real frequency past its turning point a_* (q_phys = q a b4^(-1/2) grows), where the theorem does not apply. Going below -(4 - 2 beta)/3 needs a component with rho_i < 0 (negative classical energy: a ghost-like sector)
